The outer loop scores the fit; the inner loop picks the setting.

You can't skip the outer loop.

The winner has been picked by its own score.

The score MAY look better than it is, and a tuned score would
flatter the winner.

The loop tunes each fold, making the estimate honest.

The estimate is just an average.

The spans `a; b`, `don't`, `has been`, `should`, `, making` and `just` are code.
